standard_prerequisites.name: A finite locally free morphism is affine and its direct image functor on quasi-coherent modules is exact, by the relative affine vanishing lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the exact surjection after applying f_*.

standard_prerequisites.name: The projection formula f_* f^* G = G tensor f_* O_X for the affine morphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the surjection from X to Y.

standard_prerequisites.name: For a ring map A -> B finite locally free and a finite locally free B-module N, the A-module N is finite locally free, via the algebra lemmas on finite projective modules, finite presentation under extension, and composition of flat maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies that f_* E is finite locally free over Y, so the dual surjection exhibits G as a quotient of a finite locally free module.

core_obligations: Unpack the hypothesis: f is affine and f_* O_X is finite locally free of positive rank; for a finite type quasi-coherent G on Y choose a surjection E -> f^* G with E finite locally free on X (proof lines 9529-9534).

Apply the exact functor f_* and the projection formula to get a surjection f_* E -> G tensor f_* O_X; taking duals and pairing with the locally free f_* O_X yields a surjection onto G (proof lines 9535-9546).

Verify in the footnote that f_* E is finite locally free over Y: descend flatness and finite presentation through the finite locally free ring map using the three algebra lemmas, then conclude by the finite projective criterion; hence Y has the resolution property (proof lines 9547-9563).
proof_roadmap: Lift the finite type module G to X and choose a finite locally free surjection there (proof lines 9529-9534).
Push forward with the exact affine f_*, apply the projection formula, and dualize to a surjection onto G (proof lines 9535-9546).
Check f_* E is finite locally free over Y in the footnote and conclude (proof lines 9547-9563).
